desc: Derive and validate the adjacent-difference/bitmask representation of an LCS DP row, including initialization and final LCS extraction.
Specify and verify the bit-parallel transition for appending each lowercase letter, handling masked subtraction and repeated letters in \(S\).
Precompute and aggregate the 26 letter transitions for every automaton state, retaining multiplicities modulo 998244353.
Run the \(M\)-step dynamic programming over automaton states and LCS lengths, then output answers for all \(k=0,\ldots,N\).
Implement the complete Python solution with input parsing and modulo arithmetic, and validate it against the provided samples.
